system.description: Even other Nosferatu recoil at your horrific odor. You automatically lose any challenge related to stealth against an opponent who can smell you (unless you are upwind); it's pretty hard to sneak up on someone who can smell you coming. You need not actually neglect personal hygiene to roleplay this Flaw, but wear a tag indicating your deformity.
system.source: Clanbook: Nosferatu, Chapter Two: Inside Clan Nosferatu
